While core code is updated to use `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` and per-host categories, this is a backward-compatibility break for any out-of-tree code/plugins that still call `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` or read `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts`/`SiteSetting.embed_category`, which would now raise errors after upgrade. The diff shows no deprecation shim or transitional alias.
